specialist_trace.rationale: The clinical documentation must explicitly state whether this is type 1, type 2, or another specific diabetes subtype (e.g., LADA), and clarify whether the ketosis and metabolic acidosis (pH 7.30, HCO3 16) represent diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) or a hyperglycemic crisis with ketosis, as this distinction drives both treatment and coding. Please document the physician’s interpretation linking the abnormal labs (FPG, HbA1c, pH, HCO3, ketones) to the acute metabolic decompensation, and specify if the patient is ketosis-prone or has an autoimmune etiology, to ensure accurate clinical specificity.
